newsitem.title: CHINA: China gets $80 mln loan for Kuwait oil projects.
newsitem.headline: China gets $80 mln loan for Kuwait oil projects.

text.p: An international consortium of 15 banks from Japan, Germany, France, the Netherlands and Belgium signed an $80 million loan agreement in Beijing on Wednesday with the China Petroleum Engineering Construction Corp (CPECC).
CPECC president Qin Anmin, said the loan would be used to build large oil storage facilities and oil and gas pipelines in Kuwait, the Xinhua news agency said.
The oil storage project is the largest China has ever undertaken through international bidding and the contract is worth more than $398 million, it said.

The two oil storage facilities will have an annual crude oil handling capacity of 20.5 million tonnes and daily gas handling capacity of 7.6 million cubic metres. Total length of the pipeline will be 264 km.
CPECC, a wholly owned subsidiary of the China National Petroleum Corp, is involved in oil and gas exploration, development, drilling, laying of oil and gas pipelines and construction work.
